cover_letter:
Dear Odoo Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Customer Support Analyst position at Odoo. With a technical foundation in web design and digital marketing, I have developed a strong customer-oriented approach and a knack for solving problems efficiently. At Episto, I manage client websites and maintain CRM records for a cleaning-services client, ensuring their needs are met and their experience is smooth. This hands-on experience has honed my ability to multitask, learn quickly, and communicate effectively with clients.

My background includes front-end development and SEO, giving me a solid understanding of IT and business processes. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level, and I am actively taking classes to improve. I am confident that my technical skills and customer-focused mindset align well with Odoo's mission to make customers happy through quality service. I am particularly drawn to the dynamic, startup-like environment at Odoo, where everyone's voice counts and collaboration across teams is encouraged.

In my current role, I regularly use ticketing-like systems to track and resolve client requests, and I enjoy the challenge of diagnosing issues and finding solutions. I am eager to bring my proactive attitude and willingness to learn to your support team, helping users navigate Odoo's business apps and contributing to product improvement. I am available immediately and excited about the opportunity to grow with Odoo.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
